svg.aria-label: Warrant v3 architecture. A live support agent calls one credit tool, which sends each proposal through a fixed pipeline of code steps with one model step. An act writes to the Chargebee test site. A hold posts a Slack card, and a person can keep it held, commit it, or make a standing rule.
svg.text: keep, commit or make a rule
WARRANT GATE: A FIXED LANGGRAPH PIPELINE, NOT AN AGENT
Commit, if billing has not moved
PROOF AROUND THE GATE: NEVER DECIDES
